video_title: Jimmy Butler Previews Warriors 2026-27 Season | Media Day

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says he is back to running and dunking as he continues his rehab.
quotes.excerpt: I can dunk a basketball in case anybody wants to know.
quotes.quote: I feel great. Rehab in every day. I am to a point now where I get to start running a little bit. I can dunk a basketball in case anybody wants to know. Very excited about that. It is still a process, but at least I get to play basketball a little bit now and I know that all the work that I have been putting in, it is starting to get to basketball. At first it was like you got to sit on the table and bend your knee and do all of that other stuff. Now I get to do things on the basketball court, so it makes me extremely happy.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says he is back to running and dunking as he continues his rehab. He says he is excited to be back on the court and that it makes him extremely happy.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says he is eager to return to the court and compete with his teammates.
quotes.excerpt: I want to go out there and compete with my guys, with Dray, be Robbin again to Steph's Batman.
quotes.quote: I think it is difficult for me because I do love to play basketball and I know that I will return still being able to play at a high level. But I want to hoop now. I wanted to hoop two months ago, three months ago. I want to go out there and compete with my guys, with Dray, be Robbin again to Steph's Batman. And I know I will be able to do that at an incredibly high level, but I just I miss the game. I miss not being around my guys, so any opportunity I get to be around them and and laugh, joke, compete in ways that I can compete, it is all a plus for me.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says he is eager to return to the court and compete with his teammates. He says he misses the game and being around his guys.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says he is following the team's rehab plan to ensure he returns at full strength.
quotes.quote: That is just me being stubborn and wanting to come back and hoop. The best thing about this organization is they tell you like, we not doing that. Like you got to do it the right way and not skip steps because they want me to come back and and be at full strength and and be the player that I was, that I am and that I will be. But whenever I am ready to go, I promise you I am I am coming back and it is going to be I think it is going to be like real eye popping for everybody how I am still going to be nice, probably nicer, honestly.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says he is following the team's rehab plan to ensure he returns at full strength. He says he is confident he will be even better when he returns.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler praises teammate Axel for his size, shooting ability and winning mindset.
quotes.quote: He is fucking massive. Like he is a a a big human being and he he shoots the ball so incredibly well. He is smart, he wants to learn and he is a winning player. Now I think whenever you bring in younger guys, they all just want to get busy and get to it right away, scoring and doing all of these things, and he can do that at a high level.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler praises teammate Axel for his size, shooting ability and winning mindset. He says he is a smart player who wants to learn.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says the Warriors offense has great potential due to Steph Curry's gravity.
quotes.excerpt: the potential of this offense is is great just because all the gravity that obviously Steph brings
quotes.quote: Yes, we do not want to turn the ball over. But I I think you know, some of the guys that we have on our team are are very, very, very exciting. I know that we can not cut back our turnovers, but the potential of this offense is is great just because all the gravity that obviously Steph brings, and then we got so many guys that can put the ball in the basket and they can do so many things well when it come from BP, when it come from Rook, Will, who is still a rook technically until his first game.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says the Warriors offense has great potential due to Steph Curry's gravity. He says the team has many players who can put the ball in the basket.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler jokingly says he will retire from the NBA if he scores a goal in soccer.
quotes.excerpt: But if I score a goal, you have to cancel the game.
quotes.quote: But if I score a goal, you have to cancel the game. I will never stop celebrating and I have yet to do it. So when that time comes, yeah, I am done being an NBA player.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler jokingly says he will retire from the NBA if he scores a goal in soccer. He says he will never stop celebrating.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says his rehab numbers are off the charts and he is ahead of schedule.
quotes.excerpt: my numbers are staggering, they are off the charts.
quotes.quote: I am not one for numbers. I will tell y'all all the threes, free throws, all that stuff. I am not one for numbers, but the numbers say I am doing incredibly well. So now I am a I am a person for numbers, only in like the rehab part of everything. But like my numbers are staggering, they are off the charts. I am, you know, ahead, so they say. And so I just know that all the work that I have been I have been doing, whether it be at home, in LA, in Europe, in South America, wherever the case may be, I have been doing all the right things just the way everybody has asked me to do it.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says his rehab numbers are off the charts and he is ahead of schedule. He says he has been doing all the right things in his recovery.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says he got new ear piercings while recovering from his ACL injury.
quotes.excerpt: I got some new piercings when I was out with my ACL.
quotes.quote: Oh I got some new piercings when I was out with my ACL. I had a bunch of new ear piercings that were I really do tattoos, but piercings, I like piercings. I want to get my nose pierced or anything like that, but ears.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says he got new ear piercings while recovering from his ACL injury. He says he likes piercings but does not want a nose piercing.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says he is focused on winning rather than his contract status.
quotes.excerpt: To me it is always going to be about winning. When you win, that contract stuff takes care of itself.
quotes.quote: I have made a couple buckaroos in my in my years in the league. So it ain't even about money. To me it is always going to be about winning. When you win, that contract stuff takes care of itself. I just want to get back right doing what I love. I have never once worried about a contract. I haven't. I just go out there and I play and all of that stuff happens.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says he is focused on winning rather than his contract status. He says he has never worried about a contract and just wants to play.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler says he will not change his playing style when he returns.
quotes.quote: I like one of my favorite athletes of all time is Chad Ochocinco. So I really feel like I am always open. And I tell them if I am I it is my job, if you throw it to hit the the rafters and I don't catch it, I promise you it is my fault. Because I always tell them to throw it. I am still going to run in there and run into people, get fouled. I will shoot, you know, .5 more threes, but um I am going to get back to being exactly who I am, that is what has got me to this point. I ain't changing.
quotes.social_post: Jimmy Butler says he will not change his playing style when he returns. He says he is confident in his ability to get open and compete.
